read_pdf_pages.description:
Read PDF pages and return text, images, and strikethrough annotations.

Reads the specified (or all) pages of a PDF and returns per-page text,
image annotation keys (format 'page{N}_img{M}') for later retrieval
via read_image, and any strikethrough annotations found. Filled
interactive form (AcroForm) fields are listed by name under a
'Form fields:' heading at the end of the page that holds them. Use this
tool to read and analyze PDF content. For a password-protected PDF, pass
its password in ``password``.

input.description: PDF reading settings, including the file path and optional page selection.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the PDF file. Must start with '/' and end with '.pdf'.

pages.description: (Optional) Optional list of 1-indexed page numbers to read (e.g., [1, 3, 5]). When None or omitted, all pages in the document are read.

password.description: (Optional) Password for a password-protected (encrypted) PDF. Omit it for ordinary PDFs and for PDFs that open with an empty password. When a document needs a password and none is given, the tool says so; a wrong password returns a distinct 'password ... is incorrect' error.

search_pdf.description:
Search for text occurrences across all pages of a PDF document.

Extracts text from each page and performs substring or whole-word
matching against the query. Uses parallel processing for PDFs with
more than a few pages. Returns match count, positions (page, line,
character offsets), and surrounding context for each hit. Pages whose
text could not be extracted are named in a warning. For a
password-protected PDF, pass its password in ``password``.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the PDF file. Must start with '/' and end with '.pdf'.

query.description: The text string to search for within the PDF. Must be non-empty.

case_sensitive.description: (Optional) If True, match the exact letter casing of the query. Defaults to False (case-insensitive).

whole_word.description: (Optional) If True, only match the query as a complete word (bounded by word boundaries). Defaults to False.

max_results.description: (Optional) Maximum number of matches to return. Defaults to 100. Must be a positive integer.

context_chars.description: (Optional) Number of characters of context before and after each match. Defaults to 50.

password.description: (Optional) Password for a password-protected (encrypted) PDF. Omit it for ordinary PDFs and for PDFs that open with an empty password. Without it a protected PDF returns an error (never a silent zero-match result); a wrong password returns a distinct 'password ... is incorrect' error.

create_pdf.description:
Generate a PDF document from structured blocks and optional metadata.

Builds a PDF document in the specified directory using a list of block
dictionaries. Use this tool to generate reports, letters, or any
multi-section document. Returns a confirmation string with the created
file path, or an error message if validation fails.

input.description: PDF creation settings, including the destination, content blocks, metadata, and page size.

directory.description: Target directory path. Created if it doesn't exist. Must start with '/'.

file_name.description: Name for the output PDF. Must end with '.pdf'. Cannot contain '/' (no nested path segments).

content.description: Non-empty list of content blocks. Each block must include a 'type' key. Block types: 'paragraph' (text, bold?, italic?), 'heading' (text, level 1-4?), 'bullet_list' (items), 'numbered_list' (items), 'table' (rows, header?), 'page_break', 'spacer' (height in points?).

items.description: A single content block in a PDF document.

header.description: (Optional) Bold the first row as header (table only)

metadata.description: (Optional) Optional metadata with 'title', 'subject', and/or 'author' embedded in the PDF document properties.

title.description: (Optional) Document title shown in PDF properties

read_image.description:
Retrieve an embedded image from a PDF by its annotation key.

Returns the JPEG image data for vision analysis or downstream storage.
Serves the image from the in-memory cache when a prior read_pdf_pages call
already extracted it, and otherwise extracts it from the document on demand,
so the call also succeeds on a fresh server, after cache eviction, and on
retries. The image is addressed by (document path, annotation key); no
hidden process state has to be seeded first. For a password-protected PDF,
pass its password in ``password``.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the PDF that holds the image. Must start with '/' and end with '.pdf'.

annotation.description: Image annotation key in the format 'page{N}_img{M}' (e.g., 'page1_img0') as returned in the read_pdf_pages output. A leading '@' prefix is stripped automatically. No prior call is required: an uncached image is extracted from the document on demand.

password.description: (Optional) Password for a password-protected (encrypted) PDF. Omit it for ordinary PDFs and for PDFs that open with an empty password. Pass the same password given to read_pdf_pages.

read_page_as_image.description:
Render a single PDF page as a JPEG image at 144 DPI.

Converts the specified page of a PDF into an image suitable for OCR
input, visual inspection, or thumbnail generation. Returns the
rendered image, or an error string if the file is not found, the page
number is out of range, or the document is password-protected and
``password`` is missing or wrong.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the PDF file. Must start with '/' and end with '.pdf'.

page_number.description: The page to render, 1-indexed (first page is 1). Must be between 1 and the total page count.

password.description: (Optional) Password for a password-protected (encrypted) PDF. Omit it for ordinary PDFs and for PDFs that open with an empty password. A wrong password returns a distinct 'password ... is incorrect' error.
